$comment: Classification of every standalone example under examples/ (#545).
tests/examples/run-examples.mjs fails when this list and the tree
disagree in either direction, so a new snippet cannot join without a
deliberate decision about whether CI can run it.
Fields:
file       repository-relative path, POSIX separators.
expect     substring that must appear on stdout/stderr. Required for a
runnable case: 'exited 0' on its own is also what a script
prints when its work silently did not happen — examples/io/
grpc-sensor.ts exits 0 after ten failed actor starts.
mode       'exit' (default) — must exit 0 within the budget.
'serve'          — does not exit on its own; reaching
`expect` is the pass and the harness then
stops it. Usually a server; occasionally a
snippet that finishes its work and then
keeps the loop alive (see the note on
persistence/replicated-counter.ts).
timeoutMs  per-case budget, defaults.timeoutMs otherwise.
arguments  extra argv for the example.
note       anything a reader would otherwise have to re-derive.
skip       why this one cannot run in CI. Mutually exclusive with the
fields above.

cases.skip: Spawns three cluster nodes and does not reliably reap them — two backends outlived a clean exit while classifying and held 2552/2553 against every later case. Fail-over timing on a shared runner is its own flake source; the messaging round-trip is covered by chat/smoke-test.ts.

Needs a Kubernetes API server: KubernetesLease wants apiServerUrl + authToken + caCert, or a mounted ServiceAccount at /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount. Without them it runs but never acquires, so any assertion would be about the failure path.
Not an entry point — the shared attachDevTools() helper the long-running examples import. Running it does nothing and asserts nothing; it is exercised by every case below that imports it.

Needs @grpc/grpc-js + @grpc/proto-loader. Both are optional peers with no devDependency, so they are absent from a frozen-lockfile install. Worth knowing: this one still exits 0 without them, after ten failed actor starts and a restart-threshold warning.
Needs the `nats` optional peer and a running NATS JetStream server (tests/integration/brokers/nats brings one up under Docker).
Needs the `kafkajs` optional peer and a running Kafka broker (tests/integration/brokers/kafka brings one up under Docker).
Needs the `mqtt` optional peer and an MQTT broker (tests/integration/brokers/mqtt brings one up under Docker). Without them it exits 0 having printed nothing at all.
Needs @opentelemetry/api + sdk-trace-node + exporter-trace-otlp-http, none of which the manifest declares at all, plus an OTLP collector to export to.
Needs `prom-client`, which the manifest does not declare at all.

cases.note: 'serve' for a reason that is not a server: the snippet reaches the last line of its own documented output ('convergence reached: every replica sees value=1110') and then does not exit — its three in-process nodes leave the loop alive. The assertion is the example's real result; the non-exit is a separate defect.

cases.skip: Not an entry point — WorkerNode.join() expects the bootstrap handshake that examples/worker/main.ts performs when it spawns one copy of this file per core. Run standalone it produces no output and never exits.
